scope: Non-MSA/MERC author-paper and author-code inspection; feasibility judgments are proposed adaptations, not measured gains or faithful full-model reproductions.

common_proposed_mapping.inputs: For each utterance independently: Local256 plus Base512 and three masked Gap512, each memory vector split into its actual eight 64-dimensional heads. Never use the backward zero half.
common_proposed_mapping.tokenizer: Local Linear(256,128); one shared memory Linear(64,128); five role embeddings and eight memory-head-ID embeddings. Local has no head embedding. Token count is 1+8+8*k when prior history exists, where k=0,1,2 missing modalities. IDs denote roles/heads, not an invented spatial or sequential ordering.
common_proposed_mapping.mask: torch.where before projection and after adding embeddings. Compact active tokens before the block, or masked equivalent with exact denominator exclusion. No inactive Gap/absent history token participates. No normalization across batch/conversations.
common_proposed_mapping.output_adapter: Rolewise means of block-output minus input tokens, retaining fixed Local/Base/GapA/GapT/GapV slots; concatenate640 -> Linear640,128 -> GELU -> zero-initialized Linear128,1600; add to original Flat pre-norm anchor. This output boundary is our adaptation, not part of either original paper.
common_proposed_mapping.empty_history: First valid utterance or any no-prior-history position bypasses the entire added residual as exact zero. Padding exact zero. Original Flat and Local Skip remain unchanged.
common_proposed_mapping.training: Original task loss only; all original parameters trainable. No auxiliary reconstruction, sparse-rate, contrastive, completion, distillation or gate loss.
common_proposed_mapping.preliminary_parameter_formula: Tokenizer42880 + role-pool output adapter288448 =331328 parameters, excluding block core; arithmetic estimate for exactly the dimensions above, not measured implementation counts.
common_proposed_mapping.resolved_wrapper_contract: Coordinator retains the 128d shared head-token mapping and rolewise difference pooling for Hamburger/CRATE; Equilibrium Aggregation uses its explicitly specified aggregate128 output path. Arithmetic parameter estimates still require implementation verification. No accuracy prediction is made.

papers.title: Is Attention Better Than Matrix Decomposition?
papers.license: GPL-3.0 license text verified at pinned repository LICENSE; no source code copied in this research task
papers.implementation_policy: Source-reference-only: independently implement the paper's mathematical operations and retain paper/code attribution; do not copy or translate repository source into this project without a separate license-compatibility review.
papers.corechain: Lower linear bread and ReLU -> alternating nonnegative basis/code inference -> one differentiable coefficient update -> low-rank reconstruction -> upper linear bread and normalization -> token residual and ReLU. Preserve the full chain, not just matrix multiplication.

exactmapping.matrix: Compact active evidence tokens become columns X in R^(128 x N), without imposing image-grid geometry.
exactmapping.solver: Initialize a positive normalized128x4 basis from one fixed seed at construction; copy that same immutable buffer per utterance, then reset all inferred bases/codes after each forward. Softmax initializes codes; alternate original NMF multiplicative updates under no_grad; retain the original final differentiable coefficient update and reconstruction.
exactmapping.normalization: Replace upper-bread batch normalization with tokenwise LayerNorm128 to prohibit cross-conversation dependence; 1x1 convolutions become per-token linear maps. Explicit adaptation, not exact source execution.
exactmapping.output: Use common rolewise residual readout described above; do not output estimates for inactive modality slots or write inferred factors into OSRAM.
exactmapping.critical_source_difference: Author ham.py automatically calls online_update in eval when rand_init=False. That branch MUST NOT be copied: inferred bases may never persist between utterances or test batches. Source random initialization is replaced with deterministic fresh copies to avoid introducing inference RNG drift.
exactmapping.mask_and_zero: Compact tokens before factorization; all-zero ReLU input returns zero reconstruction with epsilon denominators. Skip the entire branch if no prior history, and never infer padded tokens.
exactmapping.preliminary_parameters: Core33152 = Linear128,128(bias)16512 + upper Linear128,128(no bias)16384 + LayerNorm256. Total with proposed wrapper364480; fixed rank4 basis has512 buffer entries, not parameters. Actual count must be verified in code.

papers.why: A complete optimization-defined global-context block whose output is reconstructed from jointly inferred low-rank factors; it cannot be reduced to independent scalar/feature gates or one basic attention primitive.
papers.mechanistic_prediction_not_result: If nuisance components are inconsistent across memory heads while task-relevant components share a low-rank structure, inferred reconstruction should suppress high-rank disagreement. Inspect reconstruction rank/energy and task errors rather than interpreting small residuals as success.
limits: Real sentiment shifts may be high-rank or minority evidence and can be suppressed.
Rank4 and deterministic initialization are proposed choices, not validated MOSI hyperparameters.
Nonnegativity and tokenwise LayerNorm are modeling choices; preserving source NMF does not establish sentiment reliability.
Internal factor reconstruction is not missing-feature completion: inactive modality tokens are absent and no output is written to persistent memory.

papers.title: White-Box Transformers via Sparse Rate Reduction
papers.license: MIT; Copyright (c) 2023 Ma-Lab-Berkeley; verified pinned LICENSE
papers.implementation_policy: Prefer independent mathematical implementation with attribution. If source is copied or adapted, preserve the MIT copyright and permission notice in the distributed implementation.
papers.corechain: PreNorm -> tied-projection multihead subspace self-attention -> residual -> PreNorm -> dictionary-gradient ISTA shrinkage with ReLU; stack complete compression/sparsification blocks. The source ISTA replaces an ordinary FFN and does NOT have a second standard Transformer residual added after it.

exactmapping.tokens: Use compact active Local/memory-head evidence tokens; role/head identity embeddings replace image-patch positional embeddings. No image patch embedding or image-grid encoding.
exactmapping.attention: One shared QKV projection W generates w, and attention is softmax(w*w^T/sqrt32)*w, followed by output projection. Preserve tied projections; substituting generic unrelated Q/K/V attention changes the core mechanism.
exactmapping.ista: Preserve source FeedForward computation: x1=Linear(x,D); grad1=Linear(x1,D.T); grad2=Linear(x,D.T); output=ReLU(x +0.1*(grad2-grad1)-0.01). D is a learned128x128 dictionary, not an independent two-layer MLP.
exactmapping.task_loss: Original paper's supervised experiments use ordinary classification cross-entropy; author main.py uses LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy, then loss=criterion(output,target). Therefore no added sparse-rate objective is needed to retain the core block; MOSI keeps its existing task MSE.
exactmapping.mask_and_zero: Compact active tokens per utterance or explicitly key-mask attention and zero invalid query rows after every substep. Local is always present on valid positions, so no all-masked softmax. No-history branch bypasses residual; pad bypasses all computation.
exactmapping.output: No source CLS token required: use transformed real Local and memory rolewise differences through common wrapper. No additional OSRAM query or recurrent state.
exactmapping.preliminary_parameters: Per block49792 = two LayerNorm512 + tied projection16384 + output projection16512 + dictionary16384. Two blocks99584; total with proposed wrapper430912. Arithmetic estimate, not measured.

papers.why: Accept ONLY the complete MSSA-plus-ISTA block: jointly compressing token subspaces and sparsifying against a learned dictionary is materially different from a basic attention reweighting or a Hadamard gate. Removing ISTA would fail this screening criterion.
papers.mechanistic_prediction_not_result: Unlike Hamburger's explicit low-rank reconstruction, this branch should alter representation support through dictionary shrinkage after subspace interaction. Sparsity/support changes, and failure to retain sparse minority sentiment evidence, are separable predictions.
limits: Contains attention internally; it is not appropriate if the user bans all attention rather than simple standalone attention blocks.
CRATE is a published architecture transfer, not a new OSRAM mechanism or guaranteed innovation.
Two layers128d and rolewise readout are adaptations, not the source ImageNet model.
The low-dimensional-subspace interpretation is an inductive bias; task-only training does not prove an explicit rate objective is minimized on MOSI.

papers.title: Exploiting Problem Structure in Deep Declarative Networks: Two Case Studies
pdf_verified_sections: Robust Vector Pooling case study and structured Hessian backward derivation
papers.corechain: Solve a robust vector-centre objective sum_i phi(||u-x_i||2) by L-BFGS, then implicitly differentiate the solution through the structured Hessian; distinct from coordinatewise robustpool.py.
papers.exactmapping: Technically possible: project active evidence-head tokens to128d, compact them, solve one pseudo-Huber centre per utterance, feed it to a residual output projector. Source convex case starts at mean and uses at most100 LBFGS iterations; backward uses Hessian Cholesky solve, with fallback for singularity. Masks require compaction, empty history requires bypass. Every solve must be per utterance: original code sums a batched objective inside LBFGS, whose finite-iteration stopping/step selection can otherwise couple examples numerically. No solver state could persist.
papers.why: Does not satisfy this user's current demand for a substantial Local/Memory conflict-processing block: after all solver machinery the representational operation is one robust centre. Many correlated memory-head tokens can overwhelm the lone Local token; adding role-balancing/conditional mechanisms would invent a materially different block. Not counted toward twenty.
limits: A minority token may contain the true sentiment shift, not an outlier.
Implicit gradients require a sufficiently solved stationary point; fixed rough iterations are not an exact faithful substitute.
128-dimensional Hessian and per-utterance LBFGS can cost much more than a simple robust-pooling label suggests.
No preliminary training configuration or parameter total is proposed because candidate is rejected.

papers.title: Towards Faster Training of Global Covariance Pooling Networks by Iterative Matrix Square Root Normalization
pdf_verified_sections: Meta-layer pre-normalization, coupled Newton-Schulz iteration and post-compensation
papers.corechain: Covariance of feature samples -> trace pre-normalization -> coupled matrix-square-root iterations -> scale post-compensation -> upper-triangle vectorization.
papers.exactmapping: Could treat active head tokens as unordered samples after common projection, compute covariance only on compact valid tokens, then the full iSQRT chain. Zero covariance/no-history requires explicit bypass because author Sqrtm divides by trace without a zero-trace guard. A128d covariance is rank-deficient with at most25 active tokens; role-ID offsets also affect the covariance. Source optional reduction uses BatchNorm, which cannot be copied under cross-conversation independence.
papers.why: Verified structured pooling meta-layer but remains a statistical pooling/normalization operator for this request. It neither identifies directional Local-versus-Memory disagreement nor provides a complete conflict/shift block beyond changed aggregation. Do not count covariance, matrix square root, and triangular vectorization as separate methods to fill the list.
limits: Tiny heterogeneous token set rather than many approximately shared-distribution image locations.
Second moments discard mean and do not distinguish trustworthy changes from corrupted observations.
No proposed training configuration or claimed benefit; this is a screened rejection.

papers.title: Equilibrium Aggregation: Encoding Sets via Optimization
papers.license: No separate software license verified for the author code listings embedded in the publisher supplement
papers.implementation_policy: Source-reference-only: independently implement the mathematical energy and Nesterov update with attribution. Do not copy or directly translate the unlicensed PDF code listings, and do not describe them as an MIT-licensed author package.
papers.code_source_kind: Actual author JAX/Haiku code published as supplementary Listings1 and2; no verified standalone author Git repository. SHA256 pins the publisher PDF, not a fabricated Git commit.
papers.corechain: Typed set elements and temporary aggregate y -> shared learned nonnegative potential -> cardinality-scaled set energy plus positive L2 energy term -> unrolled Nesterov updates -> optimized aggregate. Differentiate through the complete inner loop using only the downstream task loss.

exactmapping.inputs: Use the same proposed 128d tokenizer with actual Local256 and active Base/Gap head64 inputs. Role/head IDs remain attached to each token under permutation. No head adjacency or temporal index is invented.
exactmapping.potential: Concatenate each128d token with temporary y128. Residual stages256->256->128->32: each stage has a main linear map and a skip identity or learned dimensional projection; apply tokenwise LayerNorm+tanh on the first two main branches only. The last main branch is linear. Square the final32 channels and mean them to produce nonnegative F(x_i,y). Unlike a fixed Huber centroid, this potential is learned and need not be a function only of x_i-y.
exactmapping.energy: E(X,y) = [softplus(raw_lambda)*sum(y*y) + sum_over_active_i F(x_i,y)] * log2(N+1)/(N+1e-8), preserving supplementary C.1 cardinality scaling. N counts only real active tokens. This scalar is an internal forward objective, never added to MOSI task loss.
exactmapping.initialization: At every utterance and every forward reset y0=zeros128 and momentum0=zeros128. No learned init, no reuse of the previous utterance optimum, no persistent optimizer buffers. Trainable inner scalars are shared model parameters, not state caches.
exactmapping.solver: eta=softplus(raw_eta), mu=sigmoid(raw_mu), raw_eta initialized by inverse_softplus(.125), raw_mu by logit(.9), raw_lambda by inverse_softplus(.1). For ten steps: grad=dE/dy evaluated at y+mu*v; v_new=mu*v-eta*grad; y_new=y+I(maxabs(grad)>=1e-3)*v_new. Thresholding is per utterance, never one shared batch stopping decision. All temporary state is reset per forward.
exactmapping.backprop: Training uses explicit differentiation through ten updates, including gradient-of-energy operations (PyTorch create_graph=True), not a detached solver or approximate implicit backward. Evaluation locally enables gradients only to obtain dE/dy, detaches temporary iterates between updates and does not retain outer graphs. Under inference_mode the implementation must locally disable inference mode as well as enable grad. Never call backward on the energy to accumulate parameter gradients during inference.
exactmapping.output: This method returns an aggregate rather than transformed token rows: send y_final128 through one zero-initialized Linear128,1600 and add to the original Flat pre-norm anchor. Therefore it does not use the tokenwise role-pool output adapter of the other two accepted cards. Original Flat, Memory, query and task head are untouched.
exactmapping.mask_and_empty: Compact active tokens after safe torch.where masking before all projections. Only Local and genuinely available current memory read evidence enter. No-history positions and padding bypass the whole added branch as exact zero. Defensive N=0 case returns zero without invoking the solver. No invalid token is treated as an observed zero-valued sample.
exactmapping.preliminary_parameters: Potential140608 = first stage66304 + second66048 + third8256; add three learned scalars ->140611. Shared tokenizer42880 and output projector206400 yield389891 added parameters for this exact proposal. Arithmetic estimate awaiting implementation verification.
exactmapping.author_code_caveat: Publisher Listing2 omits the loop_body carry return statement and references np in inverse_softplus without importing numpy in that listing. These publication-code omissions require explicit mechanical repair when porting; preserve its Nesterov lookahead and per-example stopping mask. Do not describe the PDF listing as a directly executed verified package.
exactmapping.training_deviation: Original experiments also use the gradient-norm auxiliary loss in main Eq5; supplementary E.3 reports its effects. The authorized task-only variant explicitly omits that outer auxiliary term. The internal positive quadratic energy term is retained because it defines the forward aggregation; it is not an extra task loss. Initial effective lambda=.1 is a fixed adaptation choice, not asserted to be the source experimental setting.
exactmapping.not_using_pyg_shortcut: Inspected current PyG equilibrium.py only as a cross-check, not author code. It differs from the publisher listings in potential squaring, residual mapping, Nesterov lookahead and energy scaling. Copying that implementation would not preserve the core chain resolved here.

papers.why: A complete learned-energy inference block: the readout representation is generated through multiple coupled optimization updates, not a simple scalar/channel gate, fixed robust mean, or one attention operation. Its expressive learned potential and unrolled inference are mechanistically distinct from Hamburger's constrained factor reconstruction and CRATE's prescribed subspace/shrinkage updates.
papers.mechanistic_prediction_not_result: The same evidence token can exert different influence as the temporary aggregate evolves, since dF(x_i,y)/dy depends on both x_i and the current y. This permits nonlinear joint set summaries without re-reading OSRAM. Finite-step energy/gradient traces can check whether the intended iterative computation operates, but neither convergence nor smaller energy proves sentiment correctness.
limits: Task-only omission of the source gradient-norm auxiliary removes a convergence aid; report this adaptation honestly.
Ten explicit inner steps need higher-order derivatives during training and increase memory/time; correctness and feasibility must be measured before any authorized run.
Nonconvex learned potentials do not guarantee a unique or global minimum. The actual deployed map is the fixed ten-step procedure, not an asserted exact equilibrium.
Memory heads outnumber Local and are correlated; role embeddings allow conditioning but do not guarantee reliability or prevent historical majority bias.
Official code evidence is publisher author listings with documented omissions, not a verified standalone GitHub repository; do not fabricate a repository or Git pin.
